interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The postoperative pathology demonstrated a Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2) and pathological T2 stage with no extraprostatic extension. Reassuring findings include negative surgical margins and no invasion of the seminal vesicles, as documented by the surgical pathology report stating, "surgical margins were negative; the seminal vesicles were not invaded." The absence of lymph node removal and the status of nodal sampling are noted as "no lymph nodes were removed," which widens uncertainty regarding nodal status, as pNx does not establish pN0. The biopsy findings indicated an Acinar growth pattern. Countervailing factors are limited by the lack of documented postoperative PSA and its trajectory, as "Postoperative PSA and its trajectory are needed; pathology alone does not establish biochemical recurrence." Information regarding postoperative PSA and its subsequent trajectory is crucial for revising the prognosis. The fixed estimated horizon is 55.69 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 36.20–75.18 months; its coverage has not been validated.
